description: Instruments AI agents to produce observable telemetry — what to log at each agent step, which metrics signal health vs. degradation, how to wire PostHog (MCP connected) for agent-specific observability, and how to detect behavioral drift before it reaches users. Datadog is NOT connected — all Datadog steps including statsd custom metrics and monitor creation are static reference guides only, clearly labeled, and not executable via MCP. Activates when setting up monitoring for an AI agent, wiring an agent to PostHog, figuring out what to log in agent interactions, detecting when an agent is getting worse, building dashboards for agent health, or setting alert thresholds for agent failure rates. Also triggers on: agent monitoring, agent observability, agent drift, agent performance tracking, LLM cost monitoring, tool call logging, agent latency, agent dashboard, agent metrics, is my agent getting worse, PostHog agent events.
